data.name: Azeezun
data.gender_notes: Azeezun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Aziz' which means 'mighty' or 'powerful'. In Islamic tradition, it is a feminine name that signifies strength and power granted by Allah. The name Azeezun carries the meaning “Powerful, Almighty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azeezun usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, almighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child blessed with immense power and grace, representing the divine attribute of Allah, Al-Aziz
data.etymology: Azeezun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Almighty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azeezun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عزيزون
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأشخاص المقربون لدي الله، الذين يتمتعون بمكانة سامية في الأسلام، وتأتي من الجذر العربي عزز، الذي يعني القوة والشرف والكرامة، وهو مصدر للعديد من الأسماء الإسلامية التي تحمل معاني سامية

in_urdu.name: عزیزون
in_urdu.long_meaning: وہ افراد جو اللہ کے نزدیک ہیں، جو اسلام میں بلند مقام رکھتے ہیں، اور یہ نام عربي جڑ سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے، جس کا مطلب قوت، شرف، اور عزت ہے

in_hindi.name: अज़ीज़ुन

in_pashto.name: عزيزون
in_pashto.long_meaning: هغه کسان چې د الله له نژدې دي، چې په اسلام کې لوړ ځای لري، او دا نوم د عربي ریښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د قوت، شرف، او عزت معنی لري

in_english.name: Azeezun
